leads.title: Exploring the Chemical Design Space of Metal-Organic Frameworks for Photocatalysis
leads.whyUnverified: A search summary tied the paper to the pred_cdp repository and the Zenodo record. On 2026-10-14 the repository's raw README and LICENSE files returned HTTP 404 on main and master, and the Zenodo record could not be opened from the verifier's network.
leads.whatToCheck: Whether the repository exists and is public, its licence, and the Zenodo record's files and licence.
